CustomField.description: STY-01874 - DnB Optimizer integrated field. Mapped during Lead Conversion.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The predicted probability (from 0 to 100) that a contact can be reached at least one of their listed phone numbers, at the time of the most recent phone verification. Decays at a rate of 2 points each month.
CustomField.label: D&B Phone Accuracy Score
